description: Heavy rain or a thunderstorm is affecting this location.
advice: Treat any outdoor plan as high risk. Postpone non-essential outdoor activity and travel, and follow official local weather alerts.

description: Extreme weather thresholds indicate potentially hazardous outdoor conditions.
advice: Avoid unnecessary outdoor activity and follow official local weather warnings.

description: Strong wind or gusts make cycling a safety risk, not just a comfort issue.
advice: Avoid cycling or riding a two-wheeler and postpone the ride until the wind eases.

description: A high chance of rain makes roads wet and slippery for cycling.
advice: Consider postponing the ride or using another mode of transport.

description: Cold temperatures make cycling uncomfortable and riskier.
advice: Dress in warm layers and postpone the ride if you cannot stay warm.

description: Very strong wind makes walking outdoors difficult and unsafe.
advice: Avoid unnecessary walking outdoors and seek shelter if conditions worsen.

description: Conditions are broadly suitable for a picnic: at least three of mild temperature, low rain chance, light wind and a fair sky hold.
advice: Go ahead with normal precautions: carry water and recheck the forecast before leaving.

description: Conditions look poor for a picnic: at least two of likely rain, strong wind, high heat and a wet sky hold.
advice: Consider moving the picnic to another day or to a sheltered spot.

description: UV levels are very high for children outdoors.
advice: Limit direct sun, seek shade and use sun protection. Prefer early morning or evening for outdoor play.

description: Very high temperature is a heat risk for children outdoors.
advice: Avoid strenuous outdoor play, stay somewhere cool and give water regularly.

description: A high chance of rain may disrupt travel.
advice: Allow extra travel time, check local conditions and alerts before departure, and consider delaying non-essential travel.

description: High temperature is a heat risk for elderly people outdoors.
advice: Limit time outdoors during the hottest hours, stay hydrated and rest in shade.

description: Strong wind or a high chance of rain may make hiking hazardous.
advice: Postpone the hike and check local trail and weather alerts.

description: Temperatures are comfortable for general outdoor plans.
advice: No specific weather risk under this rule. Stay hydrated and keep an eye on changing conditions.

description: Conditions are within normal limits for cycling: light wind, low rain chance and no extreme temperature.
advice: No weather restriction applies to cycling right now. Carry water, use sun protection and recheck before a long ride.
